title: A New Chess Game
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji took up the piece again, eyes beyond the Heavenly Dao once again gazed upon him: 'Good, this is the opponent I have been waiting for.'

text.content: When the final seal shattered, when all eyes converged with mockery and killing intent, Chen Ji smiled instead. That smile was calm to the point of cruelty, like a hunter who had waited many years finally seeing all the prey enter the net. 'Gentlemen—' his voice was not loud, yet it clearly entered each person's ear, 'Since you so desperately want to see my trump card, then as you wish.'

Before the words even finished, a vast and abyssal aura erupted from within him. The sky suddenly changed color, wind howled, and sand and stones flew through the air. The enemies who had been encircling to kill him showed horror, because that aura— it was the pressure of the Void Refining realm, and not just that, but the peak of Void Refining, only one step from Unity Tribulation! Ling Yuan's pupils contracted sharply, and the sword in his hand actually trembled involuntarily. How was this possible? He was clearly just a useless servant!

dialogue.content: 'This... this is impossible!' Ling Yuan's voice lost its usual composure, 'How long have you been hiding? How much more do you still have hidden!'

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his robes fluttering in the wild wind. He looked at Ling Yuan, his eyes showing no anger, no hatred, only a condescending indifference. 'Sect Master Ling,' his voice terrifyingly calm, 'You were chosen by the Tianji Record back then, and then abandoned by it— I can understand your resentment. But your mistake was— never should have set your sights on me.'

Ling Yuan's face turned ashen. He could feel the strange gazes from the cultivators who had originally come to watch the spectacle— those gazes held mockery, gloating. The former candidate successor of the Tianqing Sect's old Sect Master, now trampled underfoot by a废物— what a jest! His hand tightened around the sword hilt, his knuckles white, and the spiritual energy within him began to surge wildly.

choice.prompt: Facing Ling Yuan's readiness to strike, Chen Ji needed to make a choice— crush him directly to dominate and intimidate, or give him an even more humiliating option?

choices.description: Shatter Ling Yuan's pride with absolute strength, making him lose all face in front of the entire world.
choices.visible_reward: Reputation +15, prestige shocks the entire audience
choices.risk_hint: Excessive display of strength may attract the attention of more powerful forces

text.content: Chen Ji merely raised a finger, and an invisible force suddenly pressed down. Ling Yuan's entire person was struck as if by a massive mountain, his knees suddenly going soft, and with a 'thump' he knelt on the ground!

dialogue.content: 'Sect Master Ling, why bother?' Chen Ji walked over slowly, each step seeming to trample on Ling Yuan's heart, 'Kneeling for what? For Heaven? But Heaven... it cannot save you either.'

choices.description: Give Ling Yuan a choice— either kneel publicly and acknowledge his master, or be personally erased by Chen Ji.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Ling Yuan's secret loyalty (表面上敌对/表面敌对), Blackening Value +5
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan harbors resentment and may turn against him at a critical moment

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his aura, looking at Ling Yuan with a half-smile. 'Sect Master Ling, we're both smart people. The Tianqing Sect cannot do without you, and for now I also need an "archenemy". So—' his voice dropped extremely low, only Ling Yuan could hear, 'why don't we continue this play?'

dialogue.content: Scenes of humiliation, unwillingness, and fear flickered through Ling Yuan's eyes, ultimately all transforming into a somber nod. 'You've won... at least this time.' He said through gritted teeth.

choices.text: Releasing the Tiger to Return to the Mountain
choices.description: Let Ling Yuan leave, making him your 'signboard', letting all enemies think there's internal discord within the Tianqing Sect.
choices.visible_reward: Tactics +10, planting the seeds of division among enemies
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may truly rebel, bringing unpredictable variables

text.content: Chen Ji turned his back to Ling Yuan, his voice cold: 'Sect Master Ling, you may leave. Remember, the next time we meet... I won't repeat myself.'

dialogue.content: 'You...' Ling Yuan wanted to say something, but finally just snorted coldly and swept his sleeves as he departed. He knew, from this day forward, he would be seen by everyone as that loser defeated by a废物— and this was precisely what Chen Ji wanted.

text.content: After dealing with Ling Yuan, Chen Ji's gaze swept across everyone present. Those representatives from minor sects who had originally wanted to take advantage of the chaos all lowered their heads, afraid to attract the attention of this newly risen supreme expert. His gaze finally landed on a figure not far away— that was the heart strategist by the Crown Prince's side. The Crown Prince had maintained neutrality during this upheaval, but was clearly paying very close attention to Chen Ji's performance.

dialogue.content: 'Go tell the Crown Prince—' Chen Ji's voice was not loud, yet it clearly entered the strategist's ear, 'I'm not interested in his chess game. But if he's willing to treat me with sincerity, I might consider... continuing this cooperation.'

text.content: The strategist was clearly intimidated by Chen Ji's imposing manner. After a long while, he finally reacted, nodding rapidly before departing at speed. Chen Ji watched that fleeing figure's panicked back, the corner of his mouth slightly rising— the Crown Prince was ambitious, yet also knew how to assess the situation. Such a person was easiest to deal with, yet also required the most caution. Give him a taste of sweetness, and he would become your most loyal ally; but if he thinks you can be bullied, he would turn on you faster than anyone else.

Just then, the earth suddenly trembled violently. From the sky fissure that had already cracked open, a brilliant golden light shot upward, piercing straight through the clouds. That light carried an ancient and mysterious aura, causing everyone present to feel a tremor from the depths of their souls. 'The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion ruins... have completely opened!' someone cried out in alarm.

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion ruins entrance has fully opened, all forces watch with hungry eyes, Chen Ji needs to decide the next move.

choices.description: With absolute strength, enter the ruins first, gaining the maximum benefit before anyone else can react.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 10 Heavenly Fate (predicting risks within the ruins)
choices.visible_reward: Gain the initiative in the ruins, possibly finding key materials to repair the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The situation inside the ruins is unclear, there may be unknown dangers

text.content: Chen Ji's form flickered, already transforming into a stream of light rushing toward that golden pillar. His speed was惊人的, no one present could react in time. The moment he passed through the pillar, countless pieces of information flooded into his mind like a tide— that was the map of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion ruins, along with an ancient warning from antiquity: 'Those who enter must trade life for life, inquire with heart for heart.'

dialogue.content: 'Trade life for life?' Chen Ji sneered, 'Chen Ji's life is not something just anyone can trade for.' He stepped into the depths of the ruins, surrounded by a chaotic void, and his Tianji Record Fragment was faintly radiating heat— as if responding to something.

choices.text: Watching the Tigers from the Mountain Top
choices.description: Let the various forces go in first to exhaust each other, observe from the shadows and wait for the perfect moment to act.
choices.visible_reward: See through everyone's hidden cards, reap the benefits as a渔翁
choices.risk_hint: May miss the best timing, letting other forces seize the initiative

text.content: Chen Ji did not move, he merely stood quietly in place, watching those greedy cultivators rush into the ruins like moths darting into flames. A moment later, screams began to echo from the depths of the ruins, one after another, unending. Ling Yuan's expression changed— he hadn't expected the interior of the ruins to be so perilous.

dialogue.content: 'Sect Master Ling,' Chen Ji said casually, 'Would you like to go in together? I can protect you.' His tone was light, but Ling Yuan heard the mockery within it— this '废物' was using strength to tell him that without him, Ling Yuan couldn't even enter the ruins' gate.

text.content: While all forces were fighting bitterly for the ruins entrance, Chen Ji looked up into the void. He sensed it— that gaze beyond the Heavenly Dao was penetrating层层虚空, silently watching him. That gaze was cold and scrutinizing, like examining a toy that was finally starting to become interesting. Chen Ji returned that gaze, a meaningful curve appearing at the corner of his mouth. He knew, from this moment onward, he had officially become the opponent on that 'Heavenly Dao Will's' chessboard.

'Good,' a voice like coming from the nine heavens rang in his mind, 'This is the opponent I have been waiting for.' Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted, but he did not retreat, instead stepping forward toward that gaze. 'Heavenly Dao's Eye?' he coldly laughed in his heart, 'You think you're the chess player, but you don't know you're also a piece. The true chess game... has just begun.'

The killing at the ruins entrance grew increasingly brutal, all forces vying for those limited entry slots. But Chen Ji had already brought Ling Yuan into the depths of the ruins. There, an ancient stone tablet stood quietly, with a line of blurred text carved upon it. Chen Ji approached, and the text gradually became clear: 'Heaven's mandate, to resist is death, to follow is... imprisonment.' His eyes slightly narrowed— imprisonment? So this was the true secret of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion. From the beginning, the Heavenly Dao Will had been setting a trap, imprisoning all 'Heavenly Favorees' within the destiny it designed.

Just as Chen Ji was lost in contemplation, his chest suddenly felt a sharp pain. That was a warning from the Tianji Record Fragment— he foresaw a blurry scene. In the scene, Chen Nian was imprisoned by chains on a mysterious altar, surrounded by countless flickering runes. And at the altar's center, a enormous eye was slowly opening. 'Sister...' Chen Ji murmured softly, his fists clenching tightly. 'Wait for me.' He raised his head, the killing intent in his eyes almost solidifying into实质, 'Whoever you are, if you dare to touch even one hair on her head, I will make you pay the price.'
